newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Austrim bids A$1.60/share for Hawker.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Austrim bids A$1.60/share for Hawker.

text.p: Investment group Austrim Ltd said on Monday it would make an on-market takeover bid for industrial services group Hawker Richardson Ltd at A$1.60 a share.
The bid, which starts on July 8 and ends on August 7, values Hawker Richardson at A$58.31 million.
ANZ Securities, which is conducting the on-market bid for Austrim, said Austrim already had 9.48 percent of Hawker Richardson's shares.

Austrim later announced a A$42 million placement of shares to institutions at A$3.00 a share to fund the takeover and said it would announce the details of a rights issue later in the year to retire debt.
